The Office of the Registrar helps current UTSC undergraduate students with many administrative processes including: Course Enrolment and Registration , Financial Aid , Scholarships and Awards , Final Exams , Graduation , Petitions and TCards . Enrol in courses for Summer 2026 With over 300 courses to choose from, there's something for every student. Learn more here.
